name: io.github.rare-disease-atlas/orphan-disease-opportunity-mcp
description: Open venture & translational opportunity atlas for orphan diseases (Flagship #1: JAK2+ Myelofibrosis): startup blueprints, JH2 biology, Orphan Drug economics, SBIR/MPNRF/LLS grants & ethical validation.

environmentVariables.name: ATLAS_DATA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional override URL for live opportunities.json feed (defaults to https://rare-disease-atlas.github.io/opportunities.json).

environmentVariables.name: ATLAS_OFFLINE
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to force deterministic offline execution using bundled data/opportunities.json.
